clue.text: Designate an American acting award for a Shakespearean character

parts.note: to designate is to mark out or label
a Tony is the American award for Broadway theatre

explanation.surface: Nominating a US stage prize for one of the Bard's roles.
explanation.definitionFit: The Roman general who delivers the funeral oration in Julius Caesar is a famous role from the plays.

clue.text: No matter — just take care!

explanation.surface: Someone shrugs off a problem but adds a warning.
explanation.definitionFit: 'Never mind' or 'I don't mind' expresses indifference, and to mind your step is to be careful.

clue.text: Terrible argument in capital horse-riding venue

parts.note: rotten means very bad, terrible
a row is a noisy quarrel

explanation.surface: A nasty quarrel breaks out at a riding track in the city.
explanation.walkthrough: ROTTEN ROW is the sandy riding track along the south side of Hyde Park in London, the capital.
explanation.definitionFit: A bridleway in a London royal park where riders have exercised horses for centuries.

clue.text: A model set-up to produce a fabulous writer

indicators.note: in a down clue 'set-up' reads as turned upwards, so the word for model is read backwards

parts.note: to model is to pose for an artist

explanation.surface: A model's staged scene creates a marvellous author.
explanation.walkthrough: 'set-up' turns POSE into ESOP below the A; 'fabulous' means writing fables.
explanation.definitionFit: The ancient Greek storyteller is credited with fables such as the tortoise and the hare.

clue.text: Only a mug takes combat vehicle on a publichighway

parts.note: a tank is an armoured fighting vehicle
Rd is the abbreviation for road, a public highway (the space was lost in printing)

explanation.surface: Only a fool would drive an armoured vehicle on to the open road.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Only a mug' suggests a fool, but 'mug' is the drinking vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: A large drinking vessel with a handle, often pewter, used for beer.

clue.text: Not applicable to perfume in the process of development

parts.note: a scent is a perfume

explanation.surface: A form note says a fragrance question doesn't apply while it is still being created.
explanation.definitionFit: Something newly born or emerging is only beginning to grow.

clue.text: Cold boy gets dressed

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for cold, as on a tap
a lad is a boy

explanation.surface: A chilly youngster puts on clothes.
explanation.definitionFit: Clothed, wearing garments.

clue.text: Hutton's batting was revolutionary

parts.note: Len was the first name of Hutton, the England cricket captain
a batsman who is batting is in

explanation.surface: A report that a famous cricketer's innings was sensational.
explanation.walkthrough: Sir Len Hutton was an England cricketer; a batsman at the crease is 'in'. 'revolutionary' looks like praise for the innings but is the noun.
explanation.definitionFit: The Bolshevik leader of the 1917 Russian uprising.

clue.text: Dead-secret resolution caused outrage

indicators.note: resolution in its sense of breaking down into parts signals the letters being rearranged

explanation.surface: Settling a closely guarded matter provoked fury.
explanation.definitionFit: To desecrate is to violate something sacred, an act of profanation that outrages.

clue.text: Take more time to produce professional pamphlet

parts.note: pro is short for professional
a tract is a short pamphlet, often religious

explanation.surface: Writing an expert leaflet takes longer than expected.
explanation.definitionFit: To protract is to prolong or draw out, making something last longer.

clue.text: Observes retaliatory attack

indicators.note: retaliatory suggests hitting back, so the phrase for attack is read back to front

parts.note: to set on someone is to attack them

explanation.surface: Someone notices a revenge strike.
explanation.definitionFit: To note something is to observe or remark it.

clue.text: Unconditional assertion that violin, cello and bass players are missing

definitions.text: assertion that violin, cello and bass players are missing

explanation.surface: An orchestra manager's unqualified promise turns out to mean no string section.
explanation.definitionFit: A deal with no conditions attached; and literally an orchestra lacking its string section.

clue.text: A reminder to lay down Japanese wine

parts.note: to lay down wine is to keep it to mature
sake is Japanese rice wine

explanation.surface: A note to oneself to cellar some rice wine.
explanation.definitionFit: A memento kept to recall a person or occasion.

clue.text: Non-alcoholic liquor is the keynote

explanation.surface: A soft drink is said to set the mood.
explanation.definitionFit: Tonic water is a soft mixer; in music the tonic is the first note of the scale, the key note.

clue.text: Sailor may hesitate to take allowance, but it's not the norm

parts.note: AB, able seaman, is a sailor
er is the sound of hesitating
a ration is a fixed allowance

explanation.surface: A seaman dithers over accepting his daily issue, which is unusual.
explanation.definitionFit: A deviation from what is normal or expected.

clue.text: Prevent young lady from becoming a server of drinks

parts.note: to bar is to prevent
a maid is an old word for a young woman

explanation.surface: Stopping a girl from taking a job behind the pub counter.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman who serves drinks in a pub.

clue.text: Means to declare how old people are

parts.note: to aver is to declare firmly
their ages say how old people are

explanation.surface: A way to state how old everyone is.
explanation.definitionFit: Averages are arithmetic means.

clue.text: Is an art movement promoted by Russian empress?

indicators.note: movement says the letters of the phrase move around into a new order

explanation.surface: A question whether an artistic school was backed by the Tsar's wife.
explanation.definitionFit: The wife of a tsar, or a female ruler of Russia.

clue.text: The hypnotist's power made incarnate?

indicators.note: made here means fashioned anew, so the letters of the following word are reshaped

explanation.surface: A mesmerist's influence given bodily form.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags that the definition is loose: someone in this state is in the hypnotist's power.
explanation.definitionFit: A person under hypnosis is in a dazed, entranced state, subject to the mesmerist's control.

clue.text: It's quite unfair to be given unseasoned timber

definitions.text: It's quite unfair to be given

explanation.surface: Someone complains of being handed green wood.
explanation.definitionFit: A raw deal is unfair treatment; raw means unseasoned and deal is pine or fir planking.

clue.text: Pledge to carry the cases

parts.note: to lug is to carry with effort
a gage is an old word for a pledge or security

explanation.surface: A promise to take the suitcases.
explanation.definitionFit: Baggage: the suitcases and bags taken on a journey.

clue.text: Can give over the going price for fertilizer

indicators.note: give over, read as turn over, says the word for can is flipped back to front

parts.note: a tin is a can
the going rate is the current price

explanation.surface: A tin might supply the market value of plant food.
explanation.definitionFit: Nitrates are nitrogen salts spread on fields to feed crops.

clue.text: Vengeance seems in order

indicators.note: put in order means arranged, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Retribution appears to be due.
explanation.definitionFit: Named after the Greek goddess of retribution, it means an agent of downfall or vengeance.

clue.text: Greek marketplace portrayed by past painter

parts.note: ago means in the past
RA, Royal Academician, is a painter

explanation.surface: An ancient Athenian market shown in a picture by an old master.
explanation.definitionFit: The open assembly and market square of an ancient Greek city.

clue.text: Chose to work with Mr Dexter

parts.note: op, short for opus, is a work
Ted Dexter was an England cricket captain

explanation.surface: Someone decided to collaborate with a famous cricketer.
explanation.walkthrough: Ted Dexter captained England at cricket in the 1960s.
explanation.definitionFit: To opt is to make a choice; opted is its past tense.

clue.text: Good, steady walkers, but they're ready to take risks

parts.note: amblers walk at a steady, easy pace

explanation.surface: Unhurried hikers who are nonetheless happy to chance it.
explanation.definitionFit: People who bet or speculate, staking money on uncertain outcomes.

clue.text: Some symbolic items are permitted

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A few emblematic objects are allowed.
explanation.definitionFit: Lawful, allowed; describes things that are permitted.

clue.text: A former railway company needs help from charity

parts.note: the LMS, London Midland and Scottish Railway, was a British railway company until 1948

explanation.surface: A defunct rail firm has to rely on handouts.
explanation.walkthrough: The LMS was one of Britain's big four railway companies before nationalisation.
explanation.definitionFit: Money or food given to the poor as charitable relief.

clue.text: Generally where practising Catholics reaffirm their faith

definitions.text: where practising Catholics reaffirm their faith

explanation.surface: A broad observation about churchgoers' worship.
explanation.definitionFit: 'In the mass' means taken as a whole; and the Mass is the Catholic service where the Creed is said.

clue.text: Has a trainee the ability to construct a conduit?

parts.note: can means to have the ability
L, for learner, marks a trainee driver

explanation.surface: Asking whether an apprentice is skilled enough to build a pipe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Has ... the ability' is CAN; L is the learner plate on a trainee's car.
explanation.definitionFit: An artificial waterway is a channel or duct carrying water.

clue.text: The growth of the Northern poem

parts.note: an ode is a lyric poem

explanation.surface: The development of a verse from the north.
explanation.definitionFit: A knot or swelling, as on a plant stem or a lump in the body.

clue.text: Black jewellery-makers who are international socialites

parts.note: jet is a deep black
setters fix stones into jewellery mounts

explanation.surface: Dark-clad craftsmen who also mix in fashionable global society.
explanation.definitionFit: Wealthy people who fly around the world to fashionable places.
